verify_pinpunet.original_abstract_verbatim: Monitoring non-cooperative drones and, by extension, other traffic elements is one major use case of future Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) for 6 G. In our attempt to realise an ISAC-based drone monitoring system, we found that conventional micro-Doppler analysis is highly susceptible to what is coined as the smearing effect that the backscattered signal is blurred due to various reasons, rendering drone target detection intractable. To mitigate the smearing effect, we proposed PinpuNet, a data-driven learning network, to extract drone signatures from highly noisy microDoppler spectrograms. We evaluated PinpuNet on a public drone backscattered signal dataset and the drone classification result shows a substantially improved accuracy compared to generic and commonly used learning networks.

where_the_numbers_actually_live.source: arXiv:2604.02680 — Bai, Li, Yin, Qu, Hsu, Liu, Chen, 'MIMO OFDM-Enabled ISAC for Low-Altitude Non-Cooperative UAV Surveillance: A Survey' (24 p, arXiv-only, 2026)
where_the_numbers_actually_live.location: TABLE VIII (p.18) 'SUMMARY OF EXISTING ISAC-BASED UAV IDENTIFICATION METHODS', 행 'Luo et al. [89]'; 앞의 세 수치는 본문 p.16 에도 중복
where_the_numbers_actually_live.table_row_verbatim: Achieves 97.17% (4-class) and 99.50% (5-class) classification accuracy on original data. / Maintains above 91% classification accuracy even under the smearing effect. / Achieves at least 6.6% higher accuracy than the second-best model.
where_the_numbers_actually_live.body_text_verbatim_p16: The proposed method is evaluated on the LSS-FMCWR-1.0 dataset [95], which contains radar echoes of six UAV types including DJI Mavic 2, Phantom, Inspire 2, M350, M600, and a fixed-wing UAV, across K band (4-class) and L band (5-class) classification tasks. PinpuNet achieves classification accuracies of 97.17% on the K band and 99.50% on the L band, and maintains above 91% accuracy under the smearing effect.
where_the_numbers_actually_live.verdict: 우리 과제문의 '서베이 Table VIII' 귀속은 정확하다 — 축자로 그 표에 있다. 다만 이는 2차 출처이고 원문 대조는 못 했다

key_finding_dataset_is_FMCW.verdict: CONFIRMED from the ORIGINAL's own bibliography, not via the survey
key_finding_dataset_is_FMCW.evidence: PinpuNet 원문 참고문헌 ref17 (IEEE 가 Crossref 에 기탁): 'Multiband fmcw radar lss-target detection dataset (lss-fmcwr-1.0) and high-resolution micromotion feature extraction method', Chen, Journal of Radars, 2023
key_finding_dataset_is_FMCW.plus: 원문 초록도 'a public drone backscattered signal dataset' 이라고만 하고 OFDM·5G·통신파형을 일절 말하지 않는다
key_finding_dataset_is_FMCW.implication: 우리 survey_passive_ofdm_dl.json 의 gaps_found 경고 — 'PinpuNet 은 ISAC 을 표방하지만 데이터셋은 FMCW 다, OFDM 마이크로도플러 딥러닝 선례로 인용하면 안 된다' — 는 원문 근거로 지지된다. Q2(OFDM 파형 마이크로도플러 실측)의 답으로 쓰면 안 된다. ISAC 은 이 논문에서 동기부여 서사이고 측정 파형이 아니다

bonus_for_our_rotor_work.source: LSS-FMCWR-1.0 데이터셋 원문 표2 '无人机主要技术参数' (radars.ac.cn), 열 = 无人机类型 / 旋翼个数 / 转速(r/min) / 叶片长度(cm)
